answer_1.quote: We establish a transparent evaluation protocol for English image captioning models.

answer_4.quote: The first four authors of this paper conducted all evaluations...
answer_4.guideline: We base our manual evaluations on two main scores: precision and recall. We also consider three types of penalty: fluency, conciseness, and inclusive language.
